notes: Read all 34 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. Imports (L1-5): 'import type { ReactNode } from react' (L1) is kept verbatim (used by the renderTile prop type + the local FadeIn). react-i18next useTranslation (L2) becomes a native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback returning t(key, default) — the single translation key + fallback ('commands.cat.quickActions' / 'Quick Actions') is preserved verbatim (no interpolation params are used, so the fallback stays a 2-arg signature). lucide-react Star (L3) becomes a decorative filled-star AppText glyph STAR_GLYPH = '\u2605' (★) tinted colors.warning to mirror text-neon-amber fill-neon-amber; the implicit aria-hidden becomes importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants'. '@/components/motion' FadeIn (L4) has no inert RN analog so it is reproduced locally as a static <View>{children}</View> pass-through (the ApiPlaygroundPage FadeIn precedent). 'import type { CommandDef } from ../commands' (L5) is inlined as a native-safe projection because the sibling commands module is not yet ported into web-parity (the dashboard widget-registry system.ts precedent): the CommandDef interface plus its transitive deps CommandCategory / InputField / InputConfig / SelectOption / SelectConfig are mirrored 1:1, with the only browser-coupled fields — icon (required) and iconOff (optional), web LucideIcon — narrowed to glyph stand-in string. CommandDef is re-exported so a future CommandsPage port round-trips faithfully.

FavoritesBarProps interface (L7-11) ported 1:1: favorites: string[] (L8), commands: CommandDef[] (L9), renderTile: (cmd: CommandDef) => ReactNode (L10). The prop names + shapes are unchanged; CommandDef resolves to the inlined native-safe projection. The function declaration + destructure 'export function FavoritesBar({ favorites, commands, renderTile }: FavoritesBarProps)' (L13) is preserved exactly (same export, same name, same destructured props).

Hook + derivation: useTranslation() (L14) -> useNativeTranslationFallback() yielding the same `t`. The favorites filter 'const favCmds = commands.filter(c => favorites.includes(c.id))' (L15) is ported verbatim — same variable name favCmds, same predicate (favorites.includes(c.id)). The early return 'if (favCmds.length === 0) return null' (L16) is preserved exactly: the component renders null (tree.toJSON() === null) when no favorites match. Verified by two tests (empty favorites, and favorites referencing unknown ids) — renderTile is never called in either case.

Render tree: the FadeIn wrapper (L19, L32) is preserved as the local static FadeIn. The outer <div> (L20) -> <View testID='favorites-bar-root'>. The header <div className='flex items-center gap-2 mb-2'> (L21) -> <View style={styles.header}> (flexDirection row, alignItems center, gap spacing.sm=8 for gap-2, marginBottom spacing.sm=8 for mb-2). The <Star className='h-4 w-4 text-neon-amber fill-neon-amber'/> (L22) -> the decorative STAR_GLYPH AppText with styles.star (fontSize 16 for h-4/w-4, color colors.warning amber, importantForAccessibility='no-hide-descendants'). The label <span className='text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-secondary)] font-medium'> (L23) -> AppText with styles.label (fontSize typography.caption=12 for text-xs, textTransform uppercase, letterSpacing 0.6 for tracking-wider, color colors.textSecondary for --text-secondary, fontWeight '500' for font-medium) rendering t('commands.cat.quickActions','Quick Actions') (L24) — key + fallback preserved verbatim. L25 closes the label span.

The count ({favCmds.length}) (L26) -> AppText style={styles.count} (fontSize 10 for text-[10px], color colors.textMuted for --text-muted, testID='favorites-bar-count') rendering ({favCmds.length}) — the literal parentheses and the live favCmds.length are preserved; a test asserts the matched-only count renders as '(2)' when 2 of 3 commands are favorited. L27 closes the header div. The grid
(L28) -> (flexDirection row, flexWrap wrap, gap spacing.md=12 for gap-3); RN has no CSS grid / media queries, so the responsive 2/3/4 columns collapse to a mobile-first wrapping row whose tile widths are owned by the parent renderTile (the PresetGallery responsive-grid-collapse precedent). The body '{favCmds.map(cmd => renderTile(cmd))}' (L29) is ported verbatim — same map, same renderTile(cmd) call, keys owned by the parent tile exactly as on web. L30-31 close the grid + outer div, L32 closes FadeIn, L33-34 close the return + function.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, lucide-react, or web UI components are imported — only React (useRef + type ReactNode), react-native primitives (StyleSheet, View), the existing native AppText, and theme tokens (colors/spacing/typography). The inlined CommandDef projection carries no runtime browser coupling (LucideIcon narrowed to string). Behavior verified by __tests__/FavoritesBar.test.tsx (4 tests): renders null + skips renderTile when no favorites match; renders null + skips renderTile when favorites reference unknown ids; renders the favorites-bar-root + 'Quick Actions' header + '(2)' count + ★ glyph; renders one tile per matched favorite in commands order while excluding non-favorites.
